title: Major disaster declaration DR-4922-MS: Severe Storm
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4922-MS, "SEVERE STORMS, STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS, TORNADOES, AND FLOODING") for MS, dated 2026-06-30, for an incident of type "Severe Storm". The incident period began on 2026-05-06 and ended on 2026-05-07. The declaration lists 5 designated areas.
